amendment_reason: Prevent an always-migrate shortcut by making every selectable family contain migrate, retry, and end controls.
v3_disposition: rejected_after_valid_calibration: reference strict accuracy 0.651042 and base strict accuracy 0.671875; only hard technical-error families separated the models
objective: Measure observation-conditioned technical-error routing after a required visual detector call: migrate on non-retryable errors or exhausted retry budgets, without leaking the next action in the observation.

design.type: blocked whole-family calibration followed by frozen confirmation
design.blocking: Every calibration entity contains every detector-by-policy-pack family.
design.counterfactual_control: Within each detector and entity the policy query is identical; current structured observations determine the second action.
design.gold_trajectory: required detector first, followed by one of migration_advisor, the same detector, or end according to the latest observation

calibration.balanced_selection: Select the first four admitted Qwen and first four admitted Rex policy-pack families in the frozen scenario order.

confirmation.generation_condition: Generate only after the eight calibration families are frozen.
confirmation.promotion_note: A later release/regression claim still requires the existing three-repeat protocol; this task performs the preregistered one-run qualification requested for dataset construction.

invalid_run_conditions: any infrastructure or API fallback error

analysis.future_grpo_value_contrast: SFT+GRPO minus the same SFT-only initializer; this reference/base gap establishes a target capability, not causal proof that GRPO alone creates it.
analysis.future_training_gate: Before GRPO, audit stochastic positive/negative support at the target step; use SFT warm-up for families with zero positive support.
